description: Seeds two resting BTCUSDT limit orders on the scenario it is named with: the open-order list holds them and cancels are accepted by the scenario's order cancel. The position-mode switch is refused with 110028, existing open orders (the official v5 error table, #3005); the two margin-mode calls answer 110073, set margin mode failed, whose use for this refusal is unconfirmed.

merge_patch.retMsg: You have existing open orders, so the position mode cannot be switched.

POST /v5/position/switch-mode.note: No recording exists. 110028 and its message come from the official v5 error table (page dated 2026-10-14, #2893 S15; #3005): the open-order refusal of a position-mode switch, which mapping.py maps to an explicit, non-retryable rejection (never auto-switch mode). The message is the table's description, not a recorded reply.

POST /v5/position/switch-isolated.note: No recording exists. 110073, set margin mode failed, is the official v5 error table's margin-mode failure, which #2893 S15 advises for the margin-mode overlays. Whether the exchange answers a margin-mode switch with open orders this way is not verified, so the code stays flagged (README, unconfirmed codes).

POST /v5/account/set-margin-mode.note: No recording exists. 110073, set margin mode failed, is the official v5 error table's margin-mode failure, which #2893 S15 advises for the margin-mode overlays. Whether the exchange answers a margin-mode switch with open orders this way is not verified, so the code stays flagged (README, unconfirmed codes).

expected.outcome: The account holds two working BTCUSDT limit orders: rotation never cancels them (TC-205), they block a delete (TC-310), and a position-mode switch is refused with 409 conflict (TC-421).
